answer: Picture the honest agents as a karst plateau riddled with countless verified-work channels, while any sybil cluster can only link in through a narrow canyon of a few attack edges. Admission spends a scarce trust-token that must flow across this graph; the canyon min-cut caps total flow, so an army of fakes cannot each reach the summit of established standing. The attacker pays by forging genuine work-bonds with many honest nodes, not by minting cheap accounts.
